name: @df-cerebe/frontend
description: Vite + Svelte SPA dashboard. Pure static build — no Node server, no Vercel. Talks to the Hono backend over HTTP/SSE.
//deps-note: Versions PINNED EXACTLY and verified by a real install on 2026-06-11 (vite 8 ↔ plugin-svelte 7 ↔ svelte 5 ↔ svelte-check 4; @clerk/clerk-js for auth — the official framework-agnostic SDK, no Svelte wrapper needed).
